texts.zh:
我们结束了对此前抓获的[This.ContactCountry.GetName]外星人的研究。最初这些人质不太愿意与我们合作，但随着时间推移他们在无意中不断地给了我们有关他们语言的线索，一直到我们能够与他们进行基础的语言交流。从那时起，我们就能迅速拼凑有关他们的细节，一旦有一位或是更多的人质愿意合作，我们就能进入他们的电脑系统。

得益于从他们身上收集到的信息，我们能够确认他们来自[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]，并就其活动和军事实力收集到了相当多的情报。
texts.en:
We have concluded our study of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] aliens we recently captured. The hostages were initially unwilling to cooperate with us, but over time they inadvertently gave us clues to their language, until we were able to communicate with them on a basic level. From that point, we were rapidly able to piece together further details about them, eventually gaining access to their computer systems once one of the more cooperative hostages cracked.

Thanks to the information we have gleaned from them, we are able to identify them as the [This.ContactCountry.GetRealName] and have amassed considerable intelligence on their activities and capabilities.

texts.zh:
我们结束了对此前抓获的[contact_country.GetAdj]外星人的研究。这些人质显然意志薄弱，没什么阻止我们对其调查的想法。事实上，他们十分配合。我们很快就能说服他们让我们登入他们的电脑系统。

得益于这些信息，我们搜集到了关于他们国家活动和军事实力方面的大量情报。
texts.en:
We have concluded our study of the [contact_country.GetAdj] aliens we recently captured. The hostages were remarkably weak-willed and showed no particular desire to keep us from finding out about them; indeed, they proved extremely cooperative. Before long, we were able to persuade them to grant us access to their computer systems.

Thanks to the information we have gleaned from them, we have amassed considerable intelligence on their activities and capabilities.

texts.zh:
我们结束了对此前抓获的[contact_country.GetAdj]外星人的研究。这些人质表现出了极其不配合的态度，抗拒几乎所有的审讯方式。不管怎样，当我们同[contact_country.GetName]建立了通讯，我们还是取得了一些进展——其中包括获取了他们基础电脑系统的一些权限——我们“说服”了他们，让我们登录他们的电脑系统，尽管我们猜测他们能保留许多细节。

得益于这些信息，我们搜集到了关于他们国家活动和军事实力方面的大量情报。
texts.en:
We have concluded our study of the [contact_country.GetAdj] aliens we recently captured. The hostages proved remarkably unwilling to cooperate with us, resisting even the most persuasive methods of our interrogators. However, once communications were established with the [contact_country.GetName], we were able to make some progress - including gaining access to some of their basic computer systems - although we suspect that they were able to keep many details back. Before long, we were able to "persuade" them to grant us access to their computer systems.

Thanks to the information we have gleaned from them, we have amassed considerable intelligence on their activities and capabilities.

texts.zh:
我们结束了对此前抓获的[contact_country.GetAdj]机器的研究。一旦切断同人工智能主体的联系，这些无人机就失去了执行能力，并且因为其功能迅速退化，被发现几乎完全失去了作用。

幸运的是，我们想办法破解了他们的电脑系统的秘钥，[This.Owner.GetLinguists]马上就能翻译他们用来通讯的信号。现在，我们已经能够确认[This.ContactCountry.GetName]是[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]，。我们现在积累了大量有关他们活动和能力的情报。
texts.en:
We have concluded our study of the [contact_country.GetAdj] machines we recently captured. Once cut off from their parent AI, the drones lacked agency, and we were able to find out little of use from them as their functionality rapidly degraded.

Fortunately, we were able to crack the codes to their computer systems, and our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] were soon able to translate the signals they use for communication. As a result, we can now identify the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] as the [This.ContactCountry.GetRealName] and have amassed considerable intelligence on their activities and capabilities.

texts.zh:
我们结束了对于此前捕获的[This.ContactCountry.GetName]外星人的研究。看上去它们确实是由蜂巢思维所链接起来的，单独的子个体是缺少自我意识和代理权的。将其从主体意识剥离后，这些子个体似乎漫无目的，然后一个接一个地死去。除了将其作为生物标本外也没什么其他地作用了。

幸运的是，我们想办法破解了他们的电脑系统的秘钥，[This.Owner.GetLinguists]马上就能翻译他们用来通讯的信号。现在，我们已经能够确认[This.ContactCountry.GetName]是[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]，。我们现在积累了大量有关他们活动和能力的情报。
texts.en:
We have concluded our study of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] aliens we recently captured. It would appear that they are indeed organized as a hive mind, with individual drones lacking autonomy or agency. Cut off from the body, the drones seemed aimless and died off one by one, not yielding much in the way of useful information except as unwitting biological specimens.

Fortunately, we were able to crack the codes to their computer systems, and our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] were soon able to translate the signals they use for communication. As a result, we can now identify the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] as the [This.ContactCountry.GetRealName] and have amassed considerable intelligence on their activities and capabilities.

# 审讯完毕 / Interrogations Complete
- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7) · 首次接触：对方完成接触后的通知 reverse-contact notice
- 来源 Sources：`events/first_contact_events.txt:8194-8286` · `common/scripted_effects/first_contact_effects.txt:167-215` · `common/first_contact/00_first_contact.txt:1325-1425`
- 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-13（c7b-society）

## 如何开始 How it starts

当被攻击/被俘者的帝国先完成与我方的首次接触时，finish_first_contact_effect 检查我方这边仍在进行的“反向首次接触”：若其当前阶段为 default_end_stage_hostile_with_crew（含 easy / hard），则 30（+0–5）天后向我方发出本事件（`first_contact_effects.txt:167–215`）。/ When the victim’s empire finishes its own first contact first, finish_first_contact_effect checks our still-running reverse site; if its stage is default_end_stage_hostile_with_crew (also easy / hard), this event reaches us 30 (+0–5) days later.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

**审讯完成（1110）**：俘虏在通话建立后配合度提升。 / Interrogations complete: captives cooperate better once communications exist.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

单选项。效果：对其情报 +25（格式塔）/ +35（虚弱）/ +25（强壮）/ +30，并按强弱给 30%/10%/20% 科技进度。 / Single option. Effect: intel +25 (gestalt) / +35 (weak) / +25 (strong) / +30 and 30% / 10% / 20% tech progress.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

文本取决于对方是否格式塔及俘虏强弱标记。/ Text depends on gestalt status and the interrogee-strength flags.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对 Checked：脚本、finish_first_contact_effect 的反向分支、对应的敌对收尾阶段。/ Script, the reverse branch of finish_first_contact_effect and the matching hostile end stage.
- 审阅改动 Changes：无结构改动；此事件是 event-first-contact-250 篇中 285 审讯完成 的“对方先通话”版本。/ It is the “other side talked first” version of 285 审讯完成 in the event-first-contact-250 story.
